front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再点击工会对企业再培训承诺持保留态度的关键词。

back_content.text: 结论：保留态度核心词：remain deeply skeptical（深度怀疑）— 工会对企业是否真投资再培训持保留。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Workers unions have accepted the inevitability of automation but remain deeply skeptical about whether corporations will genuinely invest the savings from reduced labor costs in retraining displaced employees.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："remain deeply skeptical" = 明确保留/怀疑态度词；accepted + but remain = 让步+真实立场。② 核心规律：CET6 保留态度识别：accepted/acknowledged + but skeptical/doubtful = 表面接受，实质保留。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：unions accept automation but doubt corporate retraining commitment = 保留态度。
tips: accepted/agreed + but skeptical = 让步 + 真实保留立场，答案在 but 之后。
genuinely = 是否真诚地，unions 质疑的正是 genuinely（是否真正兑现承诺）。

audio.transcript: Workers unions have accepted the inevitability of automation but remain deeply skeptical about whether corporations will genuinely invest the savings from reduced labor costs in retraining displaced employees.

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再说出管理顾问对弹性工作安排的具体观点。

back_content.text: 结论：管理顾问观点：弹性工作安排不仅提升员工满意度，还可带来生产效率和长期留任率的可量化改善。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Management consultants argue that flexible work arrangements not only boost employee satisfaction but also lead to measurable improvements in productivity and long-term retention rates.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："argue that" = 观点引语动词；not only A but also B = 递进，两个效果均是观点核心。② 核心规律：CET6 专家观点类：argue that + positive outcome = 支持某措施的立场，答案覆盖全部列举效果。③ 验证与迁移：答案双重：employee satisfaction + productivity/retention；只涵盖一项的选项不完整。
tips: argue that = 提出观点（academic register），后接支持某做法的理由。
not only...but also = 两个论点支撑，答案需同时涵盖两点才完整。

audio.transcript: Management consultants argue that flexible work arrangements not only boost employee satisfaction but also lead to measurable improvements in productivity and long-term retention rates.

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断批评者对零工经济 "灵活性" 的立场。

back_content.text: 结论：批评者立场：灵活性是假象，掩盖了工人承担全部财务风险的本质上不稳定的雇佣关系。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Critics of the gig economy contend that its flexibility is largely illusory, masking a fundamentally precarious employment relationship in which workers bear all the financial risk.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："contend that" = 批评者明确立场；"largely illusory" = 批评核心（几乎是假象）；masking = 掩盖真相的动作。② 核心规律：CET6 批评立场：flexibility is illusory/superficial/misleading = 对表面好处的根本否定。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：speaker/critics believe the flexibility is a false claim hiding real insecurity for workers。
tips: illusory = 假象（ilusión）；masking = 掩盖，是 "看似好但实质坏" 的标准批评用词对。
fundamentally precarious = 从根本上是不稳定的，是批评者对零工经济的核心定性。

audio.transcript: Critics of the gig economy contend that its flexibility is largely illusory, masking a fundamentally precarious employment relationship in which workers bear all the financial risk.

back_content.text: 结论：工会态度：有保留的接受（accept automation）+ 深度怀疑（skeptical about genuine commitment）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Which of the following best captures the attitude of the workers unions toward corporate promises of employee retraining after automation?

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：attitude question = 需要综合立场词，not just one statement。② 核心规律：CET6 态度综合题：选项中含 "cautiously optimistic"/ "deeply skeptical"/ "broadly supportive" = 选与文本立场词最接近的。③ 验证与迁移："remain deeply skeptical" = 深度怀疑，最接近选项中含 skeptical/doubtful/reserved 的描述。
tips: 态度类综合题 = 对比选项中的情感形容词，选与原文态度词语义最匹配的。
remain + attitude adj = 强调态度持续性，是 CET6 高频态度描述句式。

Optimistic that automation will create new opportunities.

back_content.text: 结论：经济学家立场：一定程度的收入不平等不仅不可避免，而且在合理范围内可能激励创新（有条件支持）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Some economists take the view that a degree of income inequality is not only inevitable in a market economy but may actually incentivize innovation and entrepreneurship if managed within reasonable bounds.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："take the view that" = 观点持有动词；"not only inevitable but may actually" = 递进，第二推论是关键；"if managed within reasonable bounds" = 条件限制，说明是有条件的支持。② 核心规律：CET6 有条件支持立场：X is acceptable/beneficial IF Y = 有条件赞同，答案包含条件部分。③ 验证与迁移：答案：economists conditionally support some inequality as potentially beneficial for innovation。
tips: take the view that = 持有某观点（中性引语词），后接该观点内容。
if managed within bounds = 条件子句，是使整个立场成立的关键限定，不可忽略。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再说出 UBI 支持者认为其核心变革是什么。

back_content.text: 结论：支持者观点：UBI 将从根本上改变雇主与雇员的权力动态，给予工人拒绝剥削性条件的财务安全保障。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Advocates of universal basic income believe it would fundamentally alter the power dynamic between employers and employees, giving workers the financial security to refuse exploitative conditions.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："believe it would" = 支持者预期的变革效果；fundamentally alter = 根本性改变（强度词）。② 核心规律：CET6 立场改革类：advocates/believe + would = 预期效果，答案在 would 之后。③ 验证与迁移：答案核心：restructure power balance + workers gain security to reject exploitation。
tips: advocates/supporters/believers = 支持立场的引语词，后接支持该政策的理由/预期效果。
fundamentally alter = 从根本上改变，答案含 dramatic/structural/fundamental change方向。
